description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
